name: Ohio
sources: 2026 rate: $332.00 plus 2.75% of Ohio taxable nonbusiness income above $26,050 — R.C. 5747.02(A)(3)(c) as amended by HB 96 (eff. 9/30/2025): https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-5747.02
Personal and dependent exemption only if MAGI is under $500,000 from 2026 — R.C. 5747.025: https://codes.ohio.gov/ohio-revised-code/section-5747.025
Business income deduction (first $250,000 exempt, rest at 3%): https://www.keka.com/free-tools/calculators/salary-paycheck-calculator/ohio
provisional: The $26,050 cliff (tax jumps from $0 to $332.00) is modelled as 2.75% from $13,977.27, which is exact above $26,050 but overstates tax by up to $332 for Ohio taxable income between $13,977 and $26,050
Exemption fixed at $1,900 per person (the lowest tier); 2026 indexed amounts not confirmed, so filers under $80,000 MAGI are slightly overstated
Joint filing credit, senior citizen credit and $20 low-income exemption credit not included
notes: Municipal and school-district income taxes (typically 1–2.5% of wages) are not included.
Ohio's business income deduction (first $250,000 of business income exempt, the rest taxed at 3%) is not applied; self-employment income is taxed as ordinary income here.
